implementation_amendment: The initial mixed-length padded run was invalidated by a CUDA batch-versus-single audit: identical prompts changed from correct weekday names to whitespace when padded. Explicit positions did not repair it; all-ones versus omitted masks agreed for single prompts. Rerun at batch 1, prohibit padding, retain every scientific choice and gate. Old run and both audit records remain under .artifacts/gemma-weekdays. Their combined cost counts toward the original cap.
question: Can compact weekday features support natural-scale causal edits before EML equation fitting?
budget_accounting: One occupied H100 times elapsed process wall time, including shared-device delays and loading. No concurrent study jobs. Stop between batches at the phase deadline; retain partial records.
formats: Today is {day}. What day of the week will it be {offset} days later? Answer with only the weekday name.
Start on {day} and advance by {offset} days. Give only the resulting weekday.
A meeting happens on {day}. The next meeting is scheduled {offset} days afterward. Name its weekday, without explanation.
patch_site: Only the last token of the source weekday, at the output of one zero-indexed text block. The source weekday precedes the offset. No answer or future-token activations are patched.
features: Mean training hidden state per weekday; Fourier contrast matrix at harmonics 1 (rank 2) or 1,2,3 (rank 6), followed by QR. All six contrasts span arbitrary centered weekday means, so rank 6 is a categorical control, not evidence of a circle. No counterfactual-label optimization.
edits: h + alpha * U U^T (h_donor - h), with a natural donor from the same offset and format. Alpha=1 for the gate. Full-state natural donor patch is the positive control. Random control uses a seeded direction orthogonal to U, matched to each realized semantic edit's norm.
scoring: Unconditional full-vocabulary first-token argmax. Weekday names must each be one token. Restricted seven-name accuracy and logit margins are diagnostics. Paired results cluster both donor shifts and all formats by (source weekday, offset); exploratory 95% cluster bootstrap intervals, not population guarantees.

gate.selection: Among passing layer/rank pairs, choose lowest rank, then highest new-format target accuracy, then earliest layer. This is a development screen, not confirmation.

stopping: Stop this direction if no feature passes. Do not increase edit scale, train new directions, change prompts, or fit EML after inspecting a failure in this run. If a feature passes, freeze a separate equation protocol before fitting; compare EML with linear, polynomial, Fourier/bilinear, and conventional symbolic regression. Hold out new contexts, offsets and edit strengths; use three search seeds. Total combined budget remains one H100-hour.

formats: It is {day} when a trip begins. After {offset} days have elapsed, which weekday is it? Reply with the name alone.
On {day}, set a timer for exactly {offset} days. On which weekday does it finish? Only output that weekday.
confirmation_reserved.access: Not rendered, run, or scored in the prerequisite screen.

limits: Natural donor inference is allowed for causal experiments, not a deployable replacement. A successful source-token patch establishes controllability of an input representation, not a recovered addition or modulo algorithm. Seven weekday labels constrain geometric claims. Previously inspected Gemma arithmetic remains development evidence.
